name: Spotify
one_liner: Setting up OAuth with Spotify involves creating an app in their developer portal and may require approval for production access.
composio_context: Developers using Composio need their own OAuth app to access Spotify's API for custom integrations and to manage user authentication.
prerequisites: Spotify Premium Account (for some API features)

steps.title: Register a New Application
steps.description: Log into the Spotify Developer Dashboard and create a new application. Fill in the required details such as app name, description, and redirect URIs.
steps.agent_note: The developer must manually register the application and input specific details.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Settings
steps.description: Set up the OAuth credentials by noting down the Client ID and Client Secret. Configure the redirect URIs and scopes required for your application.
steps.agent_note: The developer must configure OAuth settings manually.

steps.title: Submit for Production Access
steps.description: If your app requires more than 25,000 users, submit a request for production access. This involves filling out a form detailing your app's use case and audience.
steps.agent_note: The developer must submit the production access request manually.

common_blockers.how_to_resolve: Ensure that the redirect URI in your application matches exactly with what is registered in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Contact Spotify support if the review process exceeds the typical 6-week period.

tips: Ensure your app complies with Spotify's Developer Terms.
Provide a clear and detailed use case for your app.

agent_capabilities.summary: The agent can assist with researching requirements and navigating the developer portal, but the developer must fill out forms and submit for approval.

caveats: Approval times may vary based on the completeness of the application and current review queue.
evidence.tested_notes: The agent verified the OAuth setup process through official Spotify documentation and community discussions.
